lead: Lightweight notifications. Put one `Toaster` at the app root, then call `toast()` from anywhere. Timer pausing, swipe to dismiss and screen-reader announcements come from Base UI's Toast.

layout.title: Layout
layout.stacked: When stacked, each toast tucks under the one before it

api.title: API Reference
api.functions: `<Toaster />` goes once at the app root and every toast renders in it. Toasts are shown with the `toast` functions:
api.toast: `{ title, description, type, timeout, action, onClose }`; `timeout: 0` never closes on its own
api.loading: In progress: a spinner, never closes on its own; finish with `toast.update(id, { type: 'success', … })` or `toast.close(id)`
api.promise: Updates the same toast as the promise settles
api.update: Update or close; without an id, closes them all

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles handle it in `toast.css`. Toasts render in a Portal, so `data-theme-style` must be set on `<html>`.
styling.viewport: Fixed-position container; `data-position` sets the corner, and the z-index goes here
styling.toast: One message: background, border, radius, shadow; `data-type` is its type
styling.icon: Type icon and text area; the icon takes the semantic colour of `data-type`
styling.states: States while entering, leaving and being swiped away
